Through: Mr. Rajesh P
 versus
 State Of Nct Delhi 
 Through: Mr. Raghuind
 with Si V
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order
The present petition has been filed under Section 439 CrPC seeking regular bail in connection with FIR No.29/2019 under Sections 302/498A/304B IPC registered at Police Station Jaitpur, New Delhi.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner apart from making submissions on merits, submits that the petitioner is a cancer patient and a woman, therefore, she is entitled to the benefits of proviso of Section 437 CrPC.
3. The learned APP for the State submits that the factum whether the petitioner is a cancer patient or not needs to be verified.

4. In view of the above, the Jail Superintendent is directed to furnish a medical status report of the present petitioner specifically indicating as to whether she is suffering from cancer or not and what treatment is being provided to her while in custody.

5. Re-notify on 01.05.2024.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J APRIL 10, 2024/
